```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library("ggsci")
library(genio)
```

```{r}
# calculate evaluation metrics for SAMAFS
setwd("/home/tt207/pro00108518/t2d-samafs/study2/exome_chip/cryptic-relatedness/")
bim = read_plink("/home/tt207/pro00108518/t2d-samafs/study2/exome_chip/exome_chip_qc")$bim

align_to_subset <- function(df, subset_bim, id_col, p_col) {
  idx <- match(subset_bim$id, df[[id_col]])
  df_aligned <- df[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  df_aligned$p.value <- df_aligned[[p_col]]
  df_aligned
}

# Iterate over each rep
file_names = c("joint_loco", "joint_noloco", "meta_sex_loco", "meta_sex_noloco")
combined_df = c()
for (rep_num in 1:10){
  joint_loco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_simtrait_loco.txt")
  joint_noloco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_simtrait.txt")
  meta_loco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/metal/output/simtrait_loco_", rep_num, ".1txt") 
  meta_noloco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/metal/output/simtrait_noloco_", rep_num, ".1txt")
  bim_mask_id_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/bim_mask_id.txt")
  # Read in the data
  joint_loco <- read.table(joint_loco_file, header = TRUE)
  joint_noloco <- read.table(joint_noloco_file, header = TRUE)
  meta_loco <- read.table(meta_loco_file, header = TRUE) %>% 
      select(id = MarkerName, p.value = P.value)
  meta_sex_loco = merge(meta_loco, bim, by = "id") %>% arrange(chr, pos) # meta files are merged with bim
  meta_noloco <- read.table(meta_noloco_file, header = TRUE) %>% 
      select(id = MarkerName, p.value = P.value)
  meta_sex_noloco = merge(meta_noloco, bim, by = "id") %>% arrange(chr, pos)
  # causal snp id's
  bim_mask_id <- read.table(bim_mask_id_file, header = TRUE) %>% pull(x)
  subset_bim = bim %>% filter(!id %in% bim_mask_id )
  causal_id = read.table(paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/causal_id.txt"), 
                         header = TRUE)
  causal_markers = bim[causal_id$x,] %>% pull(id)
  marker_indices = match(causal_markers, subset_bim$id)
    if (anyNA(marker_indices)) {
    bad <- causal_markers[is.na(marker_indices)]
    stop("Some causal markers are missing from subset_bim after masking. Example: ",
         paste(head(bad, 5), collapse = ", "),
         " (n_missing=", sum(is.na(marker_indices)), ")")
  }
  # filter out masked id's
  joint_loco_masked <- align_to_subset(joint_loco, subset_bim, "MarkerID", "p.value")
  joint_noloco_masked <- align_to_subset(joint_noloco, subset_bim, "MarkerID", "p.value")
  meta_sex_loco_masked <- align_to_subset(meta_sex_loco, subset_bim, "id", "p.value")
  meta_sex_noloco_masked <- align_to_subset(meta_sex_noloco, subset_bim, "id", "p.value")
  # inflation values, srmsd, aucpr
  srmsd_vals <- numeric()
  inflation_vals <- numeric() # includes all snps
  auc_vals <- numeric()

  for (file in file_names) {
    print(file)
    masked_df <- paste0(file, "_masked")
    file <- get(file)
    masked <- get(masked_df) # get df that excludes masked snps
    
    srmsd <- pval_srmsd(masked$p.value, marker_indices) 
    srmsd_vals <- c(srmsd_vals, srmsd)
    
    auc <- pval_aucpr(masked$p.value, marker_indices, curve = FALSE)
    auc_vals <- c(auc_vals, auc)

    inflation <- pval_infl(file$p.value) 
    inflation_vals <- c(inflation_vals, inflation)
    
    # print(length(masked$p.value)) # check number of snps count for mask/unmasked
    # print(length(file$p.value))
    
  }
  analysis <- c("joint-loco", "joint", "sex-meta-loco", "sex-meta")
  df <- data.frame(analysis, srmsd_vals, inflation_vals, auc_vals)
  df$rep <- rep_num
  combined_df = rbind(combined_df, df)
}

write.table(combined_df, 
            "/home/tt207/pro00108518/t2d-samafs/study2/exome_chip/cryptic-relatedness/sim_traits/samafs_eval_metric_mask_1000000.txt",
            col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# calculate evaluation metrics for HCHS/SOL
setwd("/home/tt207/pro00108518/hchs-sol/Ia/cryptic-relatedness/")
bim = read_plink("/home/tt207/pro00108518/hchs-sol/Ia/data_qc")$bim

align_to_subset <- function(df, subset_bim, id_col, p_col) {
  idx <- match(subset_bim$id, df[[id_col]])
  df_aligned <- df[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  df_aligned$p.value <- df_aligned[[p_col]]
  df_aligned
}

# Iterate over each rep
file_names = c("joint_loco", "joint_noloco", "meta_loco", "meta_noloco")
combined_df = c()
for (rep_num in 1:10){
  joint_loco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_simtrait_loco_1000.txt")
  joint_noloco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/saige_output_simtrait_1000.txt")
  meta_loco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/metal/output/simtrait_loco_", rep_num, "_1000.1txt") 
  meta_noloco_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/metal/output/simtrait_noloco_", rep_num, "_1000.1txt")
  bim_mask_id_file <- paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/bim_mask_id_1000000_1000.txt")
  # Read in the data
  joint_loco <- read.table(joint_loco_file, header = TRUE)
  joint_noloco <- read.table(joint_noloco_file, header = TRUE)
  meta_loco <- read.table(meta_loco_file, header = TRUE) %>%
      select(id = MarkerName, p.value = P.value)
  meta_sex_loco = merge(meta_loco, bim, by = "id") %>% arrange(chr, pos) # meta files are merged with bim
  meta_noloco <- read.table(meta_noloco_file, header = TRUE) %>% 
      select(id = MarkerName, p.value = P.value)
  meta_sex_noloco = merge(meta_noloco, bim, by = "id") %>% arrange(chr, pos)
  # causal snp id's
  bim_mask_id <- read.table(bim_mask_id_file, header = TRUE) %>% pull(x)
  subset_bim = bim %>% filter(!id %in% bim_mask_id )
  causal_id = read.table(paste0("./sim_traits/rep_", rep_num, "/causal_id_1000.txt"), 
                         header = TRUE)
  causal_markers = bim[causal_id$x,] %>% pull(id)
  marker_indices = match(causal_markers, subset_bim$id)
    if (anyNA(marker_indices)) {
    bad <- causal_markers[is.na(marker_indices)]
    stop("Some causal markers are missing from subset_bim after masking. Example: ",
         paste(head(bad, 5), collapse = ", "),
         " (n_missing=", sum(is.na(marker_indices)), ")")
  }
  # filter out masked id's
  joint_loco_masked <- align_to_subset(joint_loco, subset_bim, "MarkerID", "p.value")
  joint_noloco_masked <- align_to_subset(joint_noloco, subset_bim, "MarkerID", "p.value")
  meta_sex_loco_masked <- align_to_subset(meta_sex_loco, subset_bim, "id", "p.value")
  meta_sex_noloco_masked <- align_to_subset(meta_sex_noloco, subset_bim, "id", "p.value")
  # inflation values, srmsd, aucpr
  srmsd_vals <- numeric()
  inflation_vals <- numeric() # includes all snps
  auc_vals <- numeric()

  for (file in file_names) {
    print(file)
    masked_df <- paste0(file, "_masked")
    file <- get(file)
    masked <- get(masked_df) # get df that excludes masked snps
    
    srmsd <- pval_srmsd(masked$p.value, marker_indices) 
    srmsd_vals <- c(srmsd_vals, srmsd)
    
    auc <- pval_aucpr(masked$p.value, marker_indices, curve = FALSE)
    auc_vals <- c(auc_vals, auc)

    inflation <- pval_infl(file$p.value) 
    inflation_vals <- c(inflation_vals, inflation)
    
    # print(length(masked$p.value)) # check number of snps count for mask/unmasked
    # print(length(file$p.value))
    
  }
  analysis <- c("joint-loco", "joint", "sex-meta-loco", "sex-meta")
  df <- data.frame(analysis, srmsd_vals, inflation_vals, auc_vals)
  df$rep <- rep_num
  df$causal_snp <- 1000
  combined_df = rbind(combined_df, df)
}

write.table(combined_df, 
            "/home/tt207/pro00108518/hchs-sol/Ia/cryptic-relatedness/sim_traits/hchs_eval_metric_mask_1000000_causal_1000.txt",
            col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# load previously saved evaluation metrics
samafs = read.table("samafs_eval_metric_mask_1000000.txt", header = TRUE)
hchs = read.table("hchs_eval_metric_mask_1000000_causal_1000.txt", header = TRUE) %>% select(-causal_snp)

combined_df = gdata::combine(samafs, hchs)

long_df <- combined_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(srmsd_vals, inflation_vals, auc_vals),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    LOCO = grepl("loco", analysis),          # TRUE/FALSE
    analysis = sub("-loco$", "", analysis)   # remove the suffix
  ) %>% 
  mutate(LOCO = ifelse(LOCO == TRUE, "used", "not used"))

metric_labs <- c(
  "auc_vals"       = "AUC",
  "inflation_vals" = "Inflation Factor",
  "srmsd_vals"     = "SRMSDp"
)

source_labs <- c(
  "samafs"   = "SAMAFS",
  "hchs" = "HCHS-SOL"
)

library(ggh4x)
fig = ggplot(long_df, aes(x = analysis, y = value, fill = LOCO)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "Analysis", y = "Values", fill = "LOCO") +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(source),
    cols = vars(metric),
    scales = "free_y",
    independent = "y",   
    labeller = labeller(
      metric = as_labeller(metric_labs),
      source = as_labeller(source_labs)
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_nejm() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

ggsave(
  filename = "simtrait_LOCO_mask.pdf",
  plot = fig,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf
)

```
